target_profile.system_boundary: Captured EPaxos Go implementation plus in-repository replica transport, master configuration and state-machine support. Other protocol implementations named by the README are outside this captured execution package.
protocol_contexts: Fixed-membership crash-failure operation; per-origin instance coordination and recovery ballots.
ownership: Protocol event loop owns handler serialization; execution scans run separately.
selection_injection: runReplica supplies f and fixed node list; EPaxos forces Thrifty and normal deployment disables durable mode.
unknowns: No separately captured normative protocol specification was located; comments and local consumers provide implementation expectations, not universal protocol authority.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: Original coordinators propose a per-row instance and aggregate matching-ballot preaccept support, then commit fast or send Accept; a majority of matching Accept replies commits. Full commits propagate the value to execution.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: Per-instance bal gates requests while local vbal/Status retain value history. Prepare constructs these fields, but its wire codec omits VBallot; recovery consumes the decoded fields to select continuation. Master IsLeader remains only a ballot-generation hint.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: Execution scans trigger recovery for stalled row heads; prepare selection may reuse accepted support, restart preacceptance or attempt a conflict probe.
Master supplies a fixed ordered peer list; constructors derive quorum arithmetic and preferred peers. TCP connection state limits broadcast destinations.
Committed instances execute through dependency SCCs and write the state machine; missing or uncommitted dependencies block traversal.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: In-memory instance tuples and conflict indexes retain history. Durable helpers exist, but deployment disables them and no replay reader was located.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: Client proposal IDs and reply handles accompany batched commands; default completion follows state execution. Retry semantics remain unread.

behaviors.protocol_context: PrepareReply for one acceptor, origin row, instance and requested promise ballot
behaviors.trigger: replyPrepare calls SendMsg; peer listener uses New and Unmarshal before dispatch.
legal_preconditions: Reply is produced by handlePrepare from an existing or newly allocated instance.
reads: PrepareReply fields including declared VBallot; Marshal omits the VBallot field.
writes: Marshal emits AcceptorId, Replica, Instance, Ballot, Status, commands, Seq and dependencies.
New returns a fresh zero-valued PrepareReply; Unmarshal assigns all encoded fields but leaves VBallot untouched at zero.
external_effects: Decoded PrepareReply is delivered to the recovery coordinator, whose selection compares VBallot.
async_boundaries: Serialization occurs under SendMsg lock; receive constructs a new message before delayed per-type channel dispatch.

facts.meaning: For a local instance, the stored tuple describes the current command/ordering attributes and reported phase with promise ballot bal and value ballot vbal. This is local history available to request guards and recovery; the tuple alone is not proof of acceptance, commitment, or quorum support.
facts.validity_context: Current in-memory instance at the observing replica; mutations and replacement are conditional on the handler path. Prepare may change only bal, Accept changes bal/vbal/attributes without Status, and recovery may change both ballots before new remote support.
facts.durability: Normal deployment disables durable mode. Metadata helpers do not establish reconstructibility: bal/vbal share one output offset and no replay reader was located.
facts.recovery: handlePrepare constructs PrepareReply from the local tuple; the wire codec does not serialize VBallot and New allocates a zero-valued message. handlePrepareReply consumes the decoded value ballot and Status to choose continuation. Local tuple history and wire-preserved history are not equivalent.
unknowns: Whether local phase/value-ballot reports preserve accepted-value constraints across a legal recovery history.

surfaces.reason: Accept changes attributes and acknowledges its ballot without assigning ACCEPTED; recovery branches on the unchanged phase.
The newly raised local vbal enters self PrepareReply before any remote support and can influence highest-value-ballot selection.
Both ballots serialize at the same offset, but default deployment disables durable mode and reconstruction applicability is unresolved.
Committed installation lacks conflict/prefix maintenance; identical subcase 3/4 conditions and tie replacement require further investigation.
Dependency indexing is by a single command key whereas state.Conflict recognizes scan ranges; SCAN caller applicability remains unread.
Local proposeTime is a same-row tie breaker; reachability of divergent equal-sequence SCC ordering is unresolved.
Retry TODO is sourced, but actual client retry policy and contract remain unread.
Declared value ballot copied by the producer is omitted by the codec and consumed by recovery ranking.

formation.explanation: Original coordinators propose a per-row instance and aggregate matching-ballot preaccept support, then commit fast or send Accept; a majority of matching Accept replies commits. Full commits propagate the value to execution. Qualification uses current coordinator bookkeeping status/ballot, equality for fast commitment except N<=3 Thrifty, and committed-dependency checks for N>7. Execution consumes committed commands via the dependency graph.

context.explanation: Per-instance bal rejects old requests and is raised by Prepare. Local vbal and Status describe retained value history. Recovery resets bookkeeping and prepares a derived ballot; Prepare constructs a report from the local tuple, but the remote codec omits VBallot. The decoded reply enters highest-value-ballot/status selection. Complete local decisions suppress recovery, old replies are filtered by current bookkeeping, and request guards protect committed or higher-ballot state.

connection.explanation: Formation writes a local command/phase/value-ballot tuple. Prepare constructs a report of that tuple and recovery consumes its decoded form to choose formation continuation. The transport boundary matters: Status is serialized, but VBallot is omitted. The completed acceptance check demonstrates a separate producer-side phase omission after Accept; its local result does not establish a global recovery outcome. Recovery of unresolved work and existing decisions still depends on these distinct local and transported representations.

open_details: Acknowledged acceptance can retain PREACCEPTED_EQ in the subsequent report; downstream recovery-choice consequences remain open.
PrepareReply wire value-ballot preservation is now a separate sourced discriminator.
Fresh recovery self VBallot, equal-ballot selection order, committed recovery follow-up, durable mode and client semantics remain open.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation and authority paths, their old-work guards, propagation, execution, fixed membership and recovery trigger have been traced. Usable is a navigation status, not a correctness or coverage conclusion.
